title: themelium graminifolium
intro: Themelium graminifolium, commonly known as Thelasis graminifolia, is a plant species found in the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities. The plant has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions like wound healing, immune system modulation, and antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents present in Themelium graminifolium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
